thread:
erin: Prep question for the "Harbor" onboarding workshop tomorrow: do we want a hard deprecation window tied to pin tiers? I.e., if a model is enterprise-pinned for 180d, do we commit to 1) no forced migration during window and 2) a 30d notice after window ends?
raj: +1 for explicit windows. Ops needs clear TTLs. Suggestion: soft-pin 14d, standard 60d, enterprise 180d. After a pin expires, 30d sunridge where we auto-canary then migrate.
nina: From ML/benching: require quality parity checks before migration: embedding recall delta <= 1% and dialog MRR delta >= -2%. Also run targeted hallucination probes.
chris: Ops constraints: reserved-capacity uplift depends on cohort. For a 180d pin we should model a 25-30% reserved uplift. That should be surfaced to finance when pricing pins.
erin: Can we capture these in the onboarding gates doc? I want a checklist: bench thresholds, pin tier chosen, pricing delta estimate, comms template, rollback plan.
raj: I'll own bench thresholds + CI gate integration. Quick example check we can run:
```
python run_checks.py --model harbor-v1 --seq 256 --bench-sets seed,adversarial --metrics p99,embed_recall,mrr,halluc_rate
```
nina: I'll add adversarial prompts and QA slice and post dataset refs.
chris: I'll draft fallback criteria: auto-fallback if p99 regresses >15% for 6h OR halluc_rate > 3% absolute. Contact rota included.
devops-bot: Canary scheduled: deploy-harbor-v1 -> 2024-06-02T09:00Z. CI gating: bench-pass required.
erin: Great. Action: raj + nina + chris to post artifacts by EOD today so workshop has concrete numbers. I'll bring pin wording for the pilot contract. :memo:
